newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak c.bank sets 1-day rev repo tender for Tues.
newsitem.headline: Slovak c.bank sets 1-day rev repo tender for Tues.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Tuesday it had set a tender for a one-day securities reverse repurchase for 10 a.m. (0900 GMT), offering to sterilise an unspecified volume of market liquidity.

"Despite the (banking) sector's current illiquidity, we know it will reverse, we know when the money comes and we want to react to it," Peter Andresic, head of the NBS Open Market Operations Department, told Reuters.
No further tender details have been announced.
